title: porcelain Timeline
description: The single source of truth for one edit. Clips play in array order, back to back from 0; the Song is the only audio. Paths are relative to the timeline.json file. Validate with `porcelain timeline validate`.

aspect.description: 9:16 renders 1080x1920, 1:1 1080x1080, 16:9 1920x1080. Sources are scaled to cover and center-cropped.

fps.description: Constant output frame rate; Sources are resampled to it.

start.description: Offset into the Song, in seconds, heard at Timeline time 0.

text_layers.description: Text drawn over the Clips while start <= t < end.

notes.description: Free text for the Harness; ignored by render.

in.description: Source time, seconds, where the Clip starts.

out.description: Source time, seconds, where the Clip ends; greater than in and within the Source duration. For a Still, out - in is how long it is shown.

at.description: Timeline time the Clip starts: 0 for the first, then the previous Clip's at + (out - in).

effects.description: Visual treatments on this Clip, applied in a fixed order: speed_ramp, color_grade, vhs, film_grain, glitch, strobe. Each type at most once.

intensity.description: 0 looks the same as no Effect; 1 is strongest.

font.description: TTF/OTF path (normally a Brand Kit font), relative to the Timeline file.

size.description: Text height in output pixels; 0 or omitted means 1/12 of the frame height.
